mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in unemployment rate above 3.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production growth regime (INDPRO > 105.0), a subsequent monthly decline signals manufacturing supply chain disruption that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high industrial growth followed by slowdown
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105.0 and then declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers delayed rate cuts, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP expansion above 2.0% indicates robust economic growth that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market weakening that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 104.0 signals manufacturing contraction that disrupts supply chains and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 104.0, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.
